Anita: Quick follow-up from today’s all-hands on credits/quotas: if a customer is on the free tier with daily quotas and hits the daily token cap, what's the UX? Do we block only generation endpoints or also embeddings/rerankers?

Ravi: We enforce quotas per product surface. Hitting a "generation" token cap blocks generation endpoints (text, chat, streaming). Embeddings have separate quota buckets and are unaffected. Reranking is considered a generation-type workload so it's in that bucket.

Tess: For customers on free tier we show an in-console banner with the remaining daily quota and a CTA to upgrade. The billing-bot also pings the account owner if email is set.

Anita: How do rate-limits and quotas interplay during a large concurrent batch job? We had a support case where a customer hit rate caps mid-batch and got partial failures.

Ravi: Batching is tricky: rate caps are per-request concurrency and per-token throughput. If concurrency cap hits, additional requests get 429. If token throughput cap is hit mid-job, some requests will complete while others are throttled; clients should implement retries with exponential backoff and respect `Retry-After`. We also recommend using the `batching=true` option in SDKs which talks to our dedicated batch endpoint (less strict per-request caps).

Anita: Is there any separate SLA for quota replenishment or is it purely calendar-based?

Sam (CEO): Quotas reset on a calendar schedule (daily/monthly) depending on the bucket. No manual top-ups except for paid auto-recharge. Roadmap: we'll add a limited admin override for enterprise success teams to top up credits for cases like trials and pilots (target Q4).

Tess: Also FYI, streaming responses that get cut due to quota will send a final control frame with error `quota_exceeded` and HTTP 402 code if it's a billing limit; for rate-limit 429 is used. SDKs convert that into a streaming exception and close the stream.

billing-bot: Note: auto-recharge settings are at https://console.redwood.ai/billing/auto-recharge and will create an invoice.

Ravi: Practical tip: tell customers to pin model versions with `max_tokens` enforced in their prompt template; that avoids surprising mid-stream truncation.

Anita: Great, can we add a section to the runbook about offering temporary top-ups for pilot customers and the steps success should follow?

Sam (CEO): Yes. @Tess can you own the runbook addendum for trial top-ups?

Tess: On it. I will draft and share in #customer-success by EOD. :memo:
